faq.title: Clarity to design. Visibility to improve.

items.question: How can yaFlows and intelligent rules automate processes?
items.answer: In process automation, yaFlows organizes the workflow: it collects information, applies conditions and performs configured actions. Intelligent rules follow moments in the journey with communications, follow-ups, activities and updates based on events, intervals and conditions. Both can participate in the same process.

items.question: Can we already create workflows by talking to iavéh?
items.answer: Building yaFlows through conversation with iavéh is rolling out gradually. You describe the need and review the proposal before applying it. The visual builder lets you check and adjust the steps; conversational building availability depends on the rollout for your account.

items.question: Which areas can use intelligent journeys?
items.answer: Marketing and sales journeys support nurture sequences, follow-ups, proposals, stalled deals and after-sales work according to configuration. Service journeys are coming soon to extend follow-through to tickets and service stages.

items.question: Can yaFlows automate WhatsApp conversations?
items.answer: Yes. The builder combines messages and templates, buttons, lists and WhatsApp Flows forms. It also collects data, applies surveys, conditions and A/B tests, waits for responses or events, schedules steps and connects AI, activities and CRM actions. Depending on enabled channels, permissions and features, it can send Instagram messages and internal notifications, route conversations and integrate systems.

items.question: Can automations send and receive data from other systems?
items.answer: Yes. APIs, webhooks and connections can bring input data and results into builder workflows, automated journeys and AI agents according to the configuration of each path. The Mentor can use authorized queries to guide the operator. An integration depends on the available API, documentation and system access.

items.question: How do we monitor execution and control follow-through?
items.answer: Review paths before activation and follow execution details to investigate steps and responses. In journeys, define entry, exit and re-entry conditions, such as a contact reply or stage change, according to the scenario. The team retains control over adjustments and use.

items.question: Where do we start, and how do we assess the result?
items.answer: Start with a process involving manual effort or missing follow-through. Your team can organize rules, data and actions and work with specialists when needed. Define indicators and comparable periods to track time between steps, activities, failures, interventions and journey progress, considering your operation’s data and costs.
